prBodyNotes:
⚠️ **Merge only if the cluster's SPIRE server runs `{{{newMajor}}}.{{{newMinor}}}.x` or later.** SPIRE does not support an agent on a newer minor version than its server, and this PR moves the sidecar's `spire-agent` binary to `{{{newVersion}}}`. A patch bump inside the server's minor version is safe.

Check the server with `kubectl exec -n spire-server spire-server-0 -- /opt/spire/bin/spire-server --version`. If it prints a version below `{{{newMajor}}}.{{{newMinor}}}.0`, bump the SPIRE Helm chart in homelab first, then merge this.

Merging rolls every pod that runs the sidecar.
